title: SMAP enhanced L3 soil moisture (SPL3SMP_E, 9 km)
fetched: version 006: 2,817 days with retrievals, 9 cells of 9 km over the valley, morning + evening overpasses
resolution: 9 km EASE-Grid 2.0 (interpolated from ~33 km radiometer footprints); a retrieval every 2-3 days
credit: O'Neill, P. E. et al. SMAP Enhanced L3 Radiometer Global and Polar Grid Daily 9 km EASE-Grid Soil Moisture. NASA National Snow and Ice Data Center DAAC, Boulder, Colorado.
access: NASA cloud OPeNDAP (opendap.earthdata.nasa.gov), spatial subset per daily file, Earthdata bearer token
message: 2,817 retrieval days, 1,161 cell-months; 0 daily files failed; sanity passed
notes: Top ~5 cm of soil only, and each 9 km cell is mostly desert shrubland with the irrigated pivots mixed in: it shows whether the valley is wetter or drier than usual, not the moisture under one pivot. Anomaly z = (month mean - that calendar month's 2015-2025 mean) / standard deviation; months with under 5 retrieval days are left blank.
